method: Fresh Haiku and fresh Sonnet Agent-tool subagents, one group file per language and model (12 tasks), one shot; every failed first attempt then goes to a fresh subagent of the same model with the harness rejection message, one repair. A0: structured protocol, rules-merged primer (MODEL_GUIDE.rules-merged.txt, current parser). Other 48 languages: the numbered line-edit structured protocol of tools/ai-edit-apply.ts. proto1 = the protocol text before the clarification (40 languages collected here, 8 reused from the langs8 collection); proto2 = PROTOCOL_LINE_EDIT (all 48 collected fresh). A0 was collected once (its prompts and parser are unchanged between the two).
cost: o200k tokens per task; system text 1.25x on the first call and 0.05x on later calls; task+view (retry: + reply + repair) and replies 1x; session of 1, 10 tasks, unbounded.
note: Copy of results/ai-edit-b48.json with the dense A0 cell added as a separate subject (a0-dense). Canonical A0 (languages.a0) is unchanged and stays the default subject; a0Rank is canonical A0 against the 48 languages, a0DenseRank is a0-dense against the same 48 (so 49 subjects each). The dense cell was collected fresh with MODEL_GUIDE.dense.txt (145 tokens) on set b, Haiku and Sonnet, one shot plus one repair, same cost method.
